item.title: [DIS] CKB IDL: Interface Description Language and Discoverability for CKB Scripts (5 posts)
item.description: Summary One-paragraph Overview: This proposal requests a grant of $5,000 to build the next phase of the CKB IDL lifecycle: an open-source, testnet-first Script Registry for publishing, discovering, and independently verifying CKB script interfaces, together with IDL 0.1.1 empty-interface support, Molecule interoperability, and TypeScript support. It builds on the already released IDL 0.1.0 specification, Rust derive/export tooling, Rust client, binding CLI, and reference lock scripts. Deliverables include: Release CKB IDL 0.1.1, adding explicitly empty witness interfaces, with corresponding schema, specification, conformance vectors, canonicalization, commitment, and documentation...

item.title: QuotaCell: Let your team spend without handing over the treasury (1 posts)
item.description: A small update on QuotaCell since I introduced it here last week. I’ve now tested the shared spending allowance using signed transactions sent to an isolated CKB node, rather than relying only on the earlier contract tests. For the test, Alice and Ben had separate keys and spending limits, but shared an overall allowance of 100 tokens. Alice paid 60 successfully. Ben then tried to pay 50, but CKB rejected the transaction because only 40 remained in their shared allowance. When Ben tried 40 instead, it went through. The final result was 100 spent between them, with another 100 tokens still protected in the treasury. What I wanted to confirm was that the limit is enforced by CKB itself, not...

item.title: FiberNuts Community Market: A Testnet App for Cashu + Fiber (2 posts)
item.description: Hi, I tried market.fibernuts.xyz last night with two browser profiles, one as attendee and one as vendor. Worked first time. The claim took about 1.5 s and a coffee about 2 s until the vendor had fresh proofs. Nice work. Some things I ran into: I got the last faucet claim of the day (remainingToday went to 0 after 5). With the per-network cap at 3 by default, an event on shared Wi-Fi would run dry fast. Maybe an event code? Once the faucet is empty, the only way in is paying a RUSD Fiber invoice, and cashing out needs an invoice from another node. Most people at a stall won’t have either. The proofs are only in localStorage and I couldn’t find a backup step, so clearing site data or...

item.title: Omiga v1.2.0 Release: Enhanced On-Chain Asset Management and Deeper CCC Integration (1 posts)
item.description: Hi @phroi, thank you for the detailed write-up, and for taking the time to post it here even without an issue tracker to file it in. You’re right: Omiga currently only tracks the Recommended CKB address of the connected wallet, so assets held under other locks that CCC derives from the same key aren’t surfaced. This is especially relevant for users coming over from Mobit, and we’ve taken note of it. We’re now working on a plan to support moving assets from those older addresses to the new address smoothly, so that users don’t have to piece it together by hand. We expect to roll this out soon, and we’ll share an update in this thread once it’s available. Thanks again for the feedback, and...

item.title: [DIS] Kaze X CKB Unitour Continuation Proposal (1 posts)
item.description: Based on the Metaforo tally at close, the outcome is PASSED. Approval is 100%, with total voting weight of 183,340,273 CKB from 13 voters. Both the approval threshold and minimum participation requirement are met. Post-close verification was completed on 23 October 2026 using CKB DAO Watchdog, together with a manual sanity check. The verification cross-checks Metaforo-recorded voting weights against on-chain Nervos DAO deposit weights. In this run, 12 of 13 voters’ totals match exactly. One Yes entry is flagged because the voter’s current on-chain deposits are 300,000 CKB higher than the weight Metaforo recorded.
